Once your Avocado order ships, delivery times depend on the product and shipping method. For most mattresses and furniture, delivery typically takes 1–3 weeks after shipping, though this can vary based on your location and the carrier’s schedule.
If you selected In-Home Delivery, the carrier will contact you to schedule a delivery appointment once your order arrives at the local terminal. For standard shipping, delivery dates are estimated by the carrier, and you’ll receive a tracking link as soon as your order ships.
We’re committed to efficient, environmentally mindful shipping, and timelines may shift due to handcrafted production or carrier processing. If you’d like a detailed update for your specific order, please share your order number so we can look up your delivery status.
